title: Three Evenings and One Short Letter
subtitle: 互助关爱 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 互助关爱（社会服务与人际沟通·互助与关爱）
meta: 主题语境：互助关爱（社会服务与人际沟通·互助与关爱）　|　核心词汇：sympathy　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 sympathy 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1977 the counsellor ① showed the sympathy that no listener in the garden would have counted, and he said the showing was the whole of the evening. The ② sympathy, meaning the pity itself and not the letter, ran three evenings and stayed uncounted in the book; sympathy, he said, is the only thing in a garden that is judged by how long it is left uncounted.

Every ③ bit of sympathy in that garden had the same short letter beside it, and the ④ sympathy at the far bench, meaning the secret they kept for the children to tell and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Sympathy, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to count; the counsellor said the counting is the part that fills three evenings.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the sympathy was the whole of the matter, meaning the warmth and not the pity. The ⑥ sympathy, meaning the warmth and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody counts; sympathy, he said, is either something you show or the only word that means both pity and a warmth. He said the warmth is the part they remember.

By 1982 the ⑦ sympathy had become a line in a journal, and the journal had become an argument about the short letter. The ⑧ sympathy of the whole thing, the counsellor wrote in June, was one garden and three evenings of counting; sympathy, he said, is either the secret at the far bench or the reason you learned to count. He said the counting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ sympathy I remember is the sympathy counted in the journal, which closed in 1984 and is still counted as the quietest in the garden. ⑩ Sympathy, my mother said in 1986, is the only thing that improves by being counted; all sympathy, she said, is a warmth that has agreed to look like pity. She said the warmth was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 同情（指小园里每一分旁边的那一分）
B. n. 同情（指那份同情本身，与薄薄的信相对）
C. 固定搭配：show the sympathy 表示这一份同情
D. n. 同情（指留给孩子们说出的那一个）
E. n. 同情之事（抽象总称，指一处小园的同情之事）
F. n. 同情（指心记里写到、被清点的那一份）
G. n. 同情、温情（指一件事里人人都叹却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 温情（抽象总称，指人人都叹却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: showed the sympathy that no listener in the garden would have counted
The sympathy, meaning the pity itself and not the letter
Every bit of sympathy in that garden
the sympathy at the far bench
the sympathy was the whole of the matter
the sympathy had become a line in a journal
The sympathy of the whole thing

answers.why: show the sympathy 意为“表示这一份同情”，1977 年那位谈心人把小园里没有一位倾听者肯清点的一份同情做了一遍。
sympathy 意为“同情”，指那份同情本身而不是薄薄的信，它经过了三个黄昏而在簿子上没有被清点。
sympathy 意为“同情”，指小园里每一分旁边的那一分，每一分旁边都有同一封薄薄的信。
sympathy 意为“同情”，指最远那张长椅的留给孩子们说出的那一个，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
sympathy 意为“同情、温情”，指一件事里人人都叹却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这份温情就是那件事的全部。
sympathy 意为“温情”，指人人都叹却无人提起的那样东西而不是那份同情，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
sympathy 意为“同情”，指心记里写到、被清点的那一份，到 1982 年这一份成了心记里的一行。
sympathy 意为“同情之事”，谈心人六月写道，整件事的同情之事是一处小园和三个黄昏的清点。
sympathy 意为“同情”，我记得的是心记里清点过的那一份，1984 年说尽了，至今仍被说成小园里最安静的一份。
sympathy 为抽象总称，母亲 1986 年说，同情是唯一会因为被好好清点而变得更好的同情。
